items.title: SELECT basics
items.body:
SELECT id, name, created_at
FROM users
WHERE active = true AND name ILIKE '%ada%'
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 20 OFFSET 0;
items.description: Filter, sort and limit.

items.title: INNER JOIN
items.description: Only rows with a match in both tables.

items.title: LEFT JOIN with missing matches
items.body:
SELECT c.id, c.name
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
WHERE o.id IS NULL;     -- customers who never ordered
items.description: All left rows; find those with no match.

items.title: Aggregate with GROUP BY and HAVING
items.body:
SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM(total) AS revenue
FROM orders
WHERE status = 'paid'
GROUP BY customer_id
HAVING SUM(total) > 1000
ORDER BY revenue DESC;
items.description: WHERE filters rows; HAVING filters groups.

items.title: Find duplicates
items.body:
SELECT email, COUNT(*)
FROM users
GROUP BY email
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
items.description: Values that appear more than once.

items.title: Window function: ROW_NUMBER per group
items.description: Number rows within each partition.

items.title: Top N per group
items.description: Keep the first N rows of each partition.

items.title: Running total and LAG
items.body:
SELECT day, amount,
       SUM(amount) OVER (ORDER BY day) AS running_total,
       LAG(amount) OVER (ORDER BY day) AS previous_amount
FROM daily_sales;
items.description: Cumulative sum and previous-row value.

items.title: CTE (WITH)
items.description: Name a subquery to make a query readable.

items.title: CASE and COALESCE
items.body:
SELECT name,
       CASE WHEN score >= 90 THEN 'A' WHEN score >= 80 THEN 'B' ELSE 'C' END AS grade,
       COALESCE(nickname, name) AS display_name
FROM students;
items.description: Conditional values and NULL defaults.

items.title: psql: connect
items.body:
psql -h localhost -U {{user}} -d {{database}}
psql "postgres://user:password@localhost:5432/dbname"
items.description: Connect with a host, user and database, or a URL.

items.title: psql meta-commands
items.body:
\l            list databases
\c dbname     connect to a database
\dt           list tables
\d table      describe a table
\du           list roles
\dn           list schemas
\di           list indexes
\x            toggle expanded output
\timing       toggle query timing
\i file.sql   run a file
\q            quit
items.description: Explore a database from the psql prompt.

items.title: Create a database and user
items.description: Typical setup for a new app.

items.title: Backup and restore
items.body:
pg_dump -Fc -h localhost -U {{user}} {{database}} > backup.dump
pg_restore -h localhost -U {{user}} -d {{database}} --clean backup.dump
psql -U {{user}} -d {{database}} -f schema.sql
items.description: pg_dump in custom format and pg_restore.
